purpose: Source routing for adaptive read-only labor estimates: aggregate AutoStop closed-order experience, current Russia STO labor-only prices, exact vehicle context, and AUTONORMS/OEM/professional labor-time evidence.

do_not_use_as_price_basis: forum claims without a public price source

internal_experience_sources.name: Aggregate AutoStop closed repair-order experience
internal_experience_sources.capture_rule: Persist aggregate statistics only; never order ids, clients, phones, VINs, plates, payments, or raw rows.
internal_experience_sources.verification: Match exact operation and scope; compare with current market and labor time before a customer quote.

public_price_sources.name: Public STO price pages
public_price_sources.capture_rule: Capture only the short quote row: source, city/region, operation, price, includes_parts flag, capture date, and confidence.
public_price_sources.verification: Confirm the price is for labor only and the operation matches the requested vehicle class.

public_price_sources.name: FIT SERVICE public city price pages
public_price_sources.capture_rule: Use city/service pages when they expose a specific operation price; record city and whether parts are excluded.
public_price_sources.verification: Do not mix promotional bundle prices or parts/materials with labor-only work.

public_price_sources.name: Yandex Maps service cards and linked public pages
public_price_sources.capture_rule: Use only prices visible in the public card or the linked official/public service page.
public_price_sources.verification: Treat reviews and free text as context only; do not use them as price quotes.

public_price_sources.name: 2GIS service cards and public price/menu tabs
public_price_sources.capture_rule: Use only explicit public price rows or linked public price pages; record city and source.
public_price_sources.verification: Do not treat user-uploaded images as confirmed unless the operation, price, and labor-only status are clear.

public_price_sources.name: Brand-specialized STO public price pages
public_price_sources.capture_rule: Use when the requested car or operation is not comparable to a generic passenger-car price.
public_price_sources.verification: Keep labor-only price separate from aggregate/unit/parts/programming costs.

public_labor_time_sources.name: Public norm-hours / labor-time mentions
public_labor_time_sources.capture_rule: Capture only a short row: source, operation, hours/range, captured_at, confidence, public_source=true.
public_labor_time_sources.verification: Do not call public snippets official OEM norm-hours unless the source is an official public OEM/RMI page.

public_labor_time_sources.name: Public STO duration and task pages
public_labor_time_sources.capture_rule: Use only explicit public duration/labor-time rows or snippets tied to the same operation.
public_labor_time_sources.verification: Duration is a plausibility hint; price still comes from public labor-only STO quotes.

professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.name: Mitchell 1 ProDemand
professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.verification: Use only with legal access; do not copy licensed tables into docs, memory, or CRM.

professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.name: MOTOR Estimated Work Times
professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.verification: Use for norm-time verification only, not as the public Russia price average.

professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.name: TecAlliance TecDoc / Repair Data
professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.verification: Use as fallback structure check when access is legal; final price still comes from public STO quotes.

professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.name: Autodata for Cars & Vans
professional_labor_time_fallback_sources.verification: Use only as source-backed technical context; do not expose licensed rows in CRM cards.

crm_boundary.future_write_requirement: separate explicit owner command with live CRM target
